title: Surreal Head Spewing Donuts
description: A giant bald man's head with wide eyes and open mouth emerges from green rolling hills, spewing colorful donuts, spheres, snails, and cartoonish creatures from its mouth. In the background, a stained-glass church window contains multiple screaming and distressed faces and worm-like figures looking out.
